'''Tal-Na''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Voss (species)|Voss]] who lived during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. She worked as a vendor in the [[Voss-Ka Cantina]] on [[Voss]].
